messages:
lena: Noticing an aggregation mismatch on service=auth-proxy for 2026-04-02 05:00-06:00UTC. dashboard shows ~11k requests but traces only 7.8k. suspect something in serializer changes this morning.
omar: +1 I saw a spike in dropped trace_ids in the ingestion logs around the 05:12 deploy. sample log: `WARN ingestion: missing trace_id after serialize_v2`
zheng: I pulled the payloads off the ingestion buffer. looks like trace_id was getting truncated when span had binary baggage >2KB. serialization change added a compacting step that truncated trace_id bytes. bad interaction.
obs-bot: alert: aggregation_discrepancy detected for auth-proxy (delta=24%). ticket: INC-2026-421 created.
kate: Okay we need an immediate mitigation and a tracked follow-up. propose: 1) toggle serialization feature flag off 2) run targeted replay for affected window 3) create postmortem board items with owners and acceptance criteria 4) add deployment gate and synthetic end-to-end check.
lena: I'll flip the feature flag and cut a hotfix deploy. assigning to @lena for immediate mitigation.
deploy-bot: deploy started: hotfix/serializer-rollback to ingestion cluster-3 — author: lena
omar: I'll author the replay plan: replay only spans where trace_id length != 16 bytes for window 2026-04-02T05:00:00Z..2026-04-02T06:00:00Z. will do a small validation run first. owner: omar. ETA: 24h.
zheng: I'll own the codefix to remove the truncating compact step and add unit+fuzz tests for binary baggage. ETA: 2026-04-06 EOD. linking PR once ready.
lena: Hotfix deployed. starting 20m canary and monitoring metrics: ingestion_success_rate, span_coverage, aggregation_delta.
obs-bot: canary-monitor: ingestion_success_rate returning to baseline in canary window. no errors in 20m.
kate: Good. For the postmortem board: please create the following action items with acceptance criteria:
- ACTION-1: rollback serialization flag (owner: lena) 026-04-03 AM: must show ingestion_success_rate >= baseline and aggregation_delta < 2% after 1h
- ACTION-2: codefix + tests (owner: zheng) 026-04-06 COB: PR merged, CI green, unit+fuzz tests added and passing
- ACTION-3: replay missing traces (owner: omar) 026-04-04 overnight: small validation replay passes, full replay re-ingests all truncated trace_ids and dashboards reconcile
- ACTION-4: deploy gate + synthetic e2e (owner: obs team) 026-04-10: gate fails if aggregation_delta > 1% for 10m post-deploy; synthetic traces validated pre-deploy
- ACTION-5: monthly regression audit (owner: oncall rotation) 026-05-01: scheduled automated check and pager on >3% drift
zheng: creating GH issue and attaching a patch branch now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ingestion/issues/2501
omar: kicked off small validation replay for the affected partition (50 msgs). validation logs show 50/50 re-ingested, trace_id lengths normalized.
lena: Can we also add a dashboard annotation and link to the incident in the metrics timeline? want easier triage next time.
kate: Yes add annotation and add a one-line blurb in the deploy notes for the serializer change. Also we'll add a checklist item for binary baggage handling in the onboarding docs.
obs-bot: replay-status: validation replay success (50/50). queued full replay for 2026-04-02 05:00-06:00UTC at 02:00 UTC maintenance window.
zheng: PR opened with tests: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ingestion/pull/413. requesting review from infra-team.
omar: full replay finished: re-ingested ~3.2k traces; dashboards reconciled to within 0.8% of baseline.
lena: Incident INC-2026-421: immediate mitigation complete. keeping action items open until codefix + gating are merged and we run one successful production deploy with the gate.
kate: I'll convert actions into the postmortem board with owners, acceptance criteria, and set a 2-week verification window. please add any extra notes to the issue tracker. tagging this thread to INC-2026-421.
lena: Thanks team. quick retrospective note: we should warn on risky serializer changes in the pre-deploy checklist. adding that to infra docs now.
obs-bot: reminder scheduled: ACTION-5 monthly regression audit will run on 2026-05-01 at 09:00 UTC and post results to #incidents.
kate: Closing Slack thread for now. further progress will be tracked in the GH issues and postmortem board. :white_check_mark:
